# Version 4.147.0
> **Skia m147 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.147.0-preview)

> **Superseded by [4.148.0](4.148.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 4.148.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.147.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.6/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.147.0 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and new drawing APIs. This v4 preview also introduces SKPathBuilder, color font palettes, zero-copy SKStream data access, and new Linux and Tizen assets. It raises the WebAssembly floor to .NET 8 and includes API and runtime changes that require migration from v3.

## Breaking Changes

- **Assembly version moves to 4.x** — SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.147.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any version checks before adopting the preview. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo is replaced by GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses the consistently cased GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo type, and the old type loses its value-equality interface and operators. Update type references and equality checks. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **Parameterless SKFont uses an empty typeface** — A parameterless SKFont no longer resolves the platform default while drawing; its typeface is SKTypeface.Empty, so text measures to zero and does not render. Construct SKFont with SKTypeface.Default when text should use the platform default. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **WebAssembly native assets require .NET 8 or later** — Native assets for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions are removed. Move Blazor WebAssembly and Uno WebAssembly applications to .NET 8 or later before upgrading. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed** — The Skia m147 update drops Tizen arm and x86 native builds. Move Tizen deployments to arm64 or x64. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))

## Engine

- **Skia advances from m132 through m147** — The bundled renderer moves across fifteen milestones and adopts immutable SkPath internals, with SKPathBuilder providing the new managed mutation API. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp expose variation axes, named instances, design coordinates, palette selection, and per-color overrides for variable and color fonts. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Sampling options for surface drawing** — SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface gain overloads that accept SKSamplingOptions, restoring explicit filtering control when compositing surfaces. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Animated WebP encoding** — SKWebpEncoder can encode frame sequences with durations into animated WebP output using span-based overloads. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **Zero-copy access to memory-backed streams** — SKStream.GetData returns the backing SKData when the native stream can expose it directly, avoiding an intermediate copy. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **Additional document, GPU, mask filter, and HarfBuzz APIs** — Adds XPS document options, per-resource GPU flushes, shader-backed mask filters, HBColor, and previously missing HarfBuzz wrappers. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Default typeface resolution no longer crashes on Android API 36** — Default typefaces now resolve through the managed font manager with an empty-typeface fallback when no platform face is available. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744))
- **SKPath finalization no longer depends on builder collection order** — Disposal avoids flushing an SKPathBuilder after it has already been finalized, preventing a native crash on the finalizer thread. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Color-font and variation span operations are hardened** — Undersized variation buffers now follow Skia's all-or-nothing writes correctly, and SKTypeface.ContainsGlyphs no longer recurses until a stack overflow. ([#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Android SKGLView resumes rendering after tab switches** — Reattaching an SKGLView in a MAUI TabBar no longer leaves the OpenGL view blank. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets** — Adds linux-bionic native packages and Tizen arm64 and x64 builds while retiring Tizen's 32-bit targets. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry), [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Apple target frameworks accept the base 26.0 workload** — Library packages target the 26.0 Apple TFMs, while applications use unversioned TFMs so installed workloads select the matching SDK. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6

Adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, introduces HBColor for the native BGRA representation, and fills gaps in the public HarfBuzzSharp wrappers.
